# Table.Skip

```m
Table.Skip(table as table, optional countOrCondition as any) as table
```

Returns a table with the first count rows skipped.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-skip)
